title: INSHAPE: Instance-Level Shapelets for Interpretable Time-Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2605.20088v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Discovering shapelets -- i.e., discriminative temporal patterns within time series -- has been widely studied to address the inherent complexity of time-series classification (TSC) and to make model decision-making processes more transparent. However, existing methods primarily focus on population-level shapelets optimized across the entire dataset, which leads to two fundamental limitations: (i) population-level patterns often misalign with instance-specific features, resulting in suboptimal performance and potentially misleading interpretations, and (ii) most methods treat shapelets as independent entities, overlooking important temporal dependencies and interactions among multiple patterns. To address these limitations, we propose INSHAPE, an interpretable TSC framework that discovers variable-length, discriminative temporal patterns specific to each time series. INSHAPE identifies these patterns as non-overlapping segments

translated_title: INSHAPE：面向可解释时间序列分类的实例级形状特征
translated_abstract: 摘要：发现形状特征——即时间序列中具有判别性的时间模式——已被广泛研究，以解决时间序列分类（TSC）固有的复杂性，并提高模型决策过程的透明度。然而，现有方法主要关注在整个数据集上优化的群体级形状特征，这导致两个基本限制：（i）群体级模式往往与实例特定特征不一致，导致性能次优并可能产生误导性解释；（ii）大多数方法将形状特征视为独立实体，忽视了多个模式之间重要的时间依赖性和交互作用。为解决这些限制，我们提出了INSHAPE，一个可解释的TSC框架，用于发现每个时间序列特有的可变长度、判别性时间模式。INSHAPE将这些模式识别为不重叠的片段。
tldr: INSHAPE提出了一个实例级形状特征发现框架，通过识别每个时间序列特有的非重叠判别模式，克服了群体级形状特征在性能和解释性上的局限，并考虑了模式间的时间依赖关系。
en_tdlr: INSHAPE proposes an instance-level shapelet discovery framework that identifies non-overlapping discriminative patterns specific to each time series, overcoming the limitations of population-level shapelets in performance and interpretability while capturing temporal dependencies among patterns.
